title: Military Working Dog Retirement Ceremony BRoll
description: BRoll of Military Working Dog Retirement Ceremony on Fort Benning The 904th Military Working Dog Police Detachment hosted a retirement ceremony at the War Dog Memorial for two of their own military working dogs. Max, a 10-year veteran Belgian Malinois, and Grisha, another Belgian Malinois, served 4 years at Fort Benning and were recognized for their outstanding service to the police detachment. They were officially discharged from active duty service and will transition to the civilian world to live with their new families.
